# Cosmos binary JSON golden decode vectors (shared, human-reviewable).
#
# Each record has three fields:
#   name:   a unique case name
#   binary: the complete binary buffer as space-separated hex bytes,
#           including the 0x80 preamble
#   json:   the canonical text JSON the buffer decodes to
#
# Records are separated by a blank line; lines starting with # are comments.
# Keep this format in sync across language SDKs so the corpus can be shared.
